t: You're at the former London Chest Hospital in Bethnal Green, beside Victoria Park. For years it had a national reputation for treating heart and lung disease. It closed on 17 April 2015, when its services were consolidated into the new Barts Heart Centre at St Bartholomew's Hospital. It was founded by Thomas Bevill Peacock, a cardiologist who also did much to improve understanding of aortic dissection. The German-born poet and writer Karen Gershon, who escaped to Britain in December 1938, died here.
